aboutDeck.title: Engineering Origin
aboutDeck.subtitle: Bridging full-stack software and hardware engineering.
paragraphs: I am Dhruv Singh, a Computer Engineering student (Software Engineering Option) at Toronto Metropolitan University (TMU).

My passion lies at the intersection of robust full-stack software development and hands-on systems engineering from web applications and intelligent AI interfaces to microcontrollers and digital logic.
Whether crafting dynamic cloud-hosted user platforms or designing low-level processor architectures, I focus on practical engineering that solves real challenges.
aboutDeck.footer: BEng in Computer Engineering (Software Option) • TMU (2023–2028)

aboutDeck.title: Why I Build
aboutDeck.subtitle: From initial concept to software people actually use.
paragraphs: For me, software engineering is about taking an idea, breaking it down into rigorous problem statements, and building dependable systems.

I like taking a project from concept to something people can interact with optimizing route matching algorithms, automating computer vision validation on robotic rovers, or delivering intuitive AI brainstorming tools.
aboutDeck.footer: Driven by pragmatic problem solving, measurable impact, and resilient system architecture.

aboutDeck.title: Software to Silicon
aboutDeck.subtitle: Hands-on range across the stack.
paragraphs: My technical range spans from high-level web frameworks like React and Node.js to embedded C, Python automation, and digital hardware in VHDL.
Understanding how software compiles down to registers, control units, and physical signals gives me an architectural edge when optimizing web systems, memory footprints, and network communication.
aboutDeck.footer: Full-stack web applications • Embedded systems • Computer vision • Digital logic

aboutDeck.title: Current Mission
paragraphs: Building production-grade web applications and AI-integrated products with hands-on range into embedded systems and hardware.

aboutDeck.title: Looking Ahead
aboutDeck.subtitle: Continuous innovation and engineering leadership.
paragraphs: I am always looking forward to challenging engineering opportunities where I can apply full-stack development, AI workflows, and hardware insights.
Open to high-impact software engineering roles, co-op positions, and collaborative technical projects in Toronto and globally.
aboutDeck.footer: Based in Toronto, Canada • Open to Co-op & Software Engineering Opportunities
